plugins.name: Project Audit Toolkit
plugins.description: Read-only report of project structure, languages, Git status and TODO markers.
permissions: Read files under the selected project folder
Read Git status when Git is installed

plugins.name: Developer Port Inspector
plugins.description: Lists listening TCP ports and owning processes to diagnose local development servers.
permissions: Read local TCP connection and process information

plugins.name: DNS Inspector
plugins.description: Looks up DNS records for a domain using Windows DNS tools.
permissions: Make DNS queries for the domain you specify

plugins.name: HTTP Security Header Audit
plugins.description: Checks security-related HTTP response headers on a website you own or are authorized to assess.
permissions: Connect to the HTTP/HTTPS URL you specify

plugins.name: Local Network Inventory
plugins.description: Reports this computer's network adapters, IP configuration and cached ARP neighbours.
permissions: Read local adapter configuration and ARP cache
